description: This file defines a PHP class 'Template' within the namespace 'Opencart\System\Library\Template'. The class provides methods for managing template paths and rendering templates by including template files with dynamically inserted data. Key functionalities include adding template paths, rendering templates with data, and compiling templates into cached PHP files.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to manage template paths and render templates with data, including compilation to cache.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new path for templates, associating a namespace with a directory.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template file with the provided data, processing the template content and including the compiled PHP version.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the template code into a cached PHP file, storing it in the cache directory.
